name: write-for-linkedin
description: Rewrite your LinkedIn® profile, draft a post in your voice, or help reply to a recruiter or contact. Works from the facts and text you supply. Supplied-excerpt briefs are secondary. No account connection or network access.

interface.longDescription: Rewrite your LinkedIn® profile, draft a post in your voice, or help reply to a recruiter or contact. Works from the facts and text you supply. Supplied-excerpt briefs are secondary. No account connection or network access.
defaultPrompt: Rewrite my LinkedIn headline: project coordinator at Bramble Works. I manage only retail fit-outs. Target role: project manager.
Draft a plain LinkedIn post: at Bramble Works we added a handoff checklist. In one pilot only, weekly missed handoffs fell from 10 to 6. Include the percentage reduction.
Reply to this LinkedIn message: Please do not contact me again. Give me a short acknowledgment.
